task_title: AC-15 sample end-to-end trace artifact for a real repo task (docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json)
task_criteria: The artifact test file is green on this tree. PROOF: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py -q` prints 43 passed and exits 0. FAILIF: fewer than 43 passed, any failure or error, or a nonzero exit.

Regeneration is documented and byte-stable. PROOF: `python3 scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py --check` exits 0 and prints "matches a fresh build", and `grep -c gen_trace_artifact docs/prd/xml-spec-graph.md` prints 1. FAILIF: a nonzero exit, a regenerated artifact that differs from the committed bytes, or the command named in no doc (count 0).

The artifact test bites on rot. PROOF: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py -q -k "edited_artifact or unresolvable_pointer"` prints 10 passed and exits 0. FAILIF: those arms error, skip, or pass vacuously.
The trace artifact is wired into the gate. PROOF: `grep -c test_trace_artifact tests/gate.sh` prints 2. FAILIF: the count is below 2, i.e. the file runs in no gate arm.

The artifact names a real board row and a git-tracked test, not a fixture. PROOF: `jq -r .row docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json` prints AUG-136, `grep -c "AUG-136" .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` prints at least 1, and `git ls-files --error-unmatch "$(jq -r .test docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json)"` exits 0. FAILIF: the row is absent from the tracked board, the cited test path is untracked, or the artifact cites a fixture instead of a real row id.

Every chain pointer resolves or carries an explicit none-reason. PROOF: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py::test_every_pointer_resolves -q` prints 11 passed, and the committed artifact contains no bare "none" value. FAILIF: any pointer parametrization fails, or a field reads a bare none with no reason.

items.criterion: The artifact test file is green on this tree. PROOF: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py -q` prints 43 passed and exits 0. FAILIF: fewer than 43 passed, any failure or error, or a nonzero exit.
items.detail: Ran in /home/kara/auger: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py -q` -> EXIT=0, output tail `43 passed in 4.64s`; `--co` confirms `43 tests collected`; `-rs` run shows no skips (`43 passed in 2.92s`).

items.criterion: Regeneration is documented and byte-stable. PROOF: `python3 scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py --check` exits 0 and prints "matches a fresh build", and `grep -c gen_trace_artifact docs/prd/xml-spec-graph.md` prints 1. FAILIF: a nonzero exit, a regenerated artifact that differs from the committed bytes, or the command named in no doc (count 0).
items.detail: `python3 scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py --check` -> EXIT=0, stdout `trace artifact matches a fresh build: docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json (1487 bytes)`. `grep -c gen_trace_artifact docs/prd/xml-spec-graph.md` -> 1 (line 293: `python3 scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py` writes `docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json`). Byte stability independently confirmed: `python3 scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py --out /tmp/fresh.json` then `cmp /tmp/fresh.json docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json` -> BYTE-IDENTICAL.

items.criterion: The artifact test bites on rot. PROOF: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py -q -k "edited_artifact or unresolvable_pointer"` prints 10 passed and exits 0. FAILIF: those arms error, skip, or pass vacuously.
items.detail: `-k "edited_artifact or unresolvable_pointer"` -> EXIT=0, `10 passed, 33 deselected in 1.07s`. `--collect-only` shows the 10 are real arms: test_check_mode_fails_on_an_edited_artifact plus 9 parametrizations of test_the_generator_refuses_an_unresolvable_pointer (--row AUG-999999, --spec unknown id, --spec stale file, --test missing file, --test bad selector, --doc, --evidence, --commit, --wave). Not vacuous: each asserts rc==2 and a typed `spec error (<code>)` in stderr (tests/test_trace_artifact.py:352-372), and I reproduced the behaviour by hand — `--row AUG-999999` -> rc=2 `spec error (unknown-trace-row)`.

items.criterion: The trace artifact is wired into the gate. PROOF: `grep -c test_trace_artifact tests/gate.sh` prints 2. FAILIF: the count is below 2, i.e. the file runs in no gate arm.
items.detail: `grep -c test_trace_artifact tests/gate.sh` -> 2: line 201 (comment naming the AUG-141 artifact) and line 206, the actual `python3 -m pytest ... tests/test_trace_artifact.py ...` arm. tests/test_trace_artifact.py:487-509 (test_gate_arm_runs_this_file) additionally asserts the file is in the gate's pytest arm and that every file named there exists.

items.criterion: The artifact names a real board row and a git-tracked test, not a fixture. PROOF: `jq -r .row docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json` prints AUG-136, `grep -c "AUG-136" .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` prints at least 1, and `git ls-files --error-unmatch "$(jq -r .test docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json)"` exits 0. FAILIF: the row is absent from the tracked board, the cited test path is untracked, or the artifact cites a fixture instead of a real row id.
items.detail: `jq -r .row` -> `AUG-136`; `grep -c "AUG-136" .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` -> 7 (line 230 is the real row `{"status": "complete", "id": "AUG-136", ...}`); `git ls-files --error-unmatch tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py` -> prints the path, EXIT=0. The cited test is a real suite file, not a fixture (tests/fixtures/ is a separate directory).

items.criterion: Every chain pointer resolves or carries an explicit none-reason. PROOF: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py::test_every_pointer_resolves -q` prints 11 passed, and the committed artifact contains no bare "none" value. FAILIF: any pointer parametrization fails, or a field reads a bare none with no reason.
items.detail: `pytest tests/test_trace_artifact.py::test_every_pointer_resolves -q` -> EXIT=0, `11 passed in 0.20s`; verbose run shows all 11 params PASSED (row, spec, wave, test, doc, prompt, evidence, witness, verdict, commit, memory). Bare-none check: `jq -r 'to_entries[] | select(.value=="none") | .key'` and `jq -r '.marker[] | select(endswith("=none"))'` both return nothing; every absence reads `none:<reason>` (e.g. wave=none:no-wave-record, verdict=none:no-gitreins-verdict). The generator also refuses a bare none: `--wave none` -> rc=2 `spec error (unexplained-absent-field): wave=none gives no reason`.

items.criterion: The generator's --check actually detects drift (a mutated artifact is refused with nonzero exit), not just prints "matches".
items.detail: Mutated a copy of the artifact (evidence -> docs/prd/xml-spec-graph-proofs.json) and ran `scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py --check --out /tmp/stale.json`: rc=1, stderr `stale trace artifact: stale.json differs from a fresh build` + `evidence: on disk 'docs/prd/xml-spec-graph-proofs.json' != fresh 'docs/SPEC-CORPUS-VIEW.md'` (scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py:390-410).

items.criterion: The artifact's marker round-trips through the shipped parser (auger.parse_trace_marker) and covers all 11 SPEC_TRACE_FIELDS.
items.detail: Ran `auger.parse_trace_marker(" ".join(artifact['marker']))`: `parsed keys: 11 expected: 11`, `set equal: True`, `values agree: True` (auger.py:11894 SPEC_TRACE_FIELDS, auger.py:9694 parse_trace_marker). Also covered by test_the_marker_parses_through_the_shipped_parser and test_the_shipped_checker_accepts_the_marker, both green in the 43-passed run.

items.criterion: The generator refuses a bare `none` value and an unresolvable pointer with a typed error and writes no artifact.
items.detail: `--wave none --out /tmp/bad3.json` -> rc=2, `spec error (unexplained-absent-field): wave=none gives no reason — write wave=none:<reason>`, and `ls /tmp/bad3.json` -> No such file. `--row AUG-999999 --out /tmp/bad2.json` -> rc=2 `spec error (unknown-trace-row)` and no file. Refusal path returns before the write (scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py:381-386).

items.criterion: The cited commit pointer is reachable from HEAD (ancestor), so the trace is followable from the published tip.
items.detail: `git cat-file -e 3f64a4e^{commit}` EXIT=0 and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 3f64a4e HEAD` EXIT=0; the artifact's resolution map records `commit: git-commit 3f64a4e (ancestor of HEAD)`. Enforced by test_the_commit_pointer_is_an_ancestor_of_head (green in the 43-passed run).

items.criterion: The artifact is byte-identical to a fresh build (committed bytes == generator output), i.e. no hand-editing.
items.detail: `python3 scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py --out /tmp/fresh.json` (EXIT=0) then `cmp /tmp/fresh.json docs/prd/evidence/AUG-136-trace.json` -> BYTE-IDENTICAL; `--check --out /tmp/fresh.json` -> rc=0 `matches a fresh build ... (1487 bytes)`. Also asserted by test_a_double_build_is_byte_identical.
